query:
SELECT ms.name as setName, mc.cardType, mc.parallels, COUNT(*) as cardCount
FROM marvel_cards mc 
JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id 
GROUP BY ms.name, mc.cardType, mc.parallels
ORDER BY ms.name, mc.cardType
LIMIT 50;
